maximum_tumour_diameter_mm.description: Maximum tumour diameter in mm, or 'Not identified'. Leave empty if not dictated.

tumour_type.description: Select Other/adenocarcinoma variant when a non-conventional type or variant is dictated.

other_tumour_type.description: Specify the other tumour type or adenocarcinoma variant; leave empty for conventional adenocarcinoma.

maximum_invasive_depth_mm.description: For pT1 tumours, maximum depth of invasive tumour from the muscularis mucosae in mm, or 'Not assessable'.

invasive_tumour_width_mm.description: For pT1 tumours, width of invasive tumour in mm, or 'Not assessable'.

nodes_examined.description: Total number of lymph nodes examined; defaults to 0 when not stated.

nodes_positive.description: Number of involved lymph nodes; defaults to 0 when not stated.

tumour_bud_count.description: Number of buds identified in a 0.785 mm2 H&E hotspot; leave empty if not stated.

tumour_budding_grade.description: Bd1: fewer than 5 buds; Bd2: 5-9 buds; Bd3: more than 9 buds, counted on H&E within a 0.785 mm2 hotspot.

enum: TRS 1 - Single cells or rare small groups of cancer cells
TRS 2 - Residual cancer with evident tumour regression

peripheral_margin_involvement.description: Whether the peripheral margin is involved by carcinoma.

deep_margin_involvement.description: Whether the deep margin is involved by carcinoma.

carcinoma_to_deep_margin_mm.description: Histological measurement from carcinoma to the nearest deep excision margin in mm, or 'Not assessable'.

resection_status.description: R0 = complete resection; R1 = microscopic residual tumour; R2 = macroscopic residual tumour.

tnm_prefix.description: Use y after preoperative therapy; otherwise use No prefix.

tumour_block.description: Representative tumour block or blocks; leave empty if not stated.
